Title: Welcome to EU-HEM!
Message:
Welcome to Bologna and to the program! This hub collects the timetable, exam dates and a city guide in one place.
Questions? Ask your class representatives.

Title: Welcome aperitivo
Message: Join us for a welcome aperitivo on Friday evening, a relaxed way to meet the new cohort.

Title: How to register for exams
Message: Exam registration is done on AlmaEsami. Registration for each exam opens about two weeks before the exam date, so check the Exams section regularly.

Title: Discounted annual bus pass
Message: UniBo students can buy the subsidised annual TPER bus pass through Studenti Online. See the City Guide for details.

Title: Statistics study group
Message:
A weekly study group for Statistics for Healthcare is starting.
We meet after Thursday's class in the study room. Everyone is welcome!

Title: Weekend trip to Ravenna
Message: Day trip to Ravenna on Saturday to see the mosaics. Train from Bologna Centrale, about 1 hour 20 minutes each way. Sign up in the class group.

Title: Study room Wi-Fi maintenance this afternoon
Message: The Wi-Fi in the study rooms will be unavailable this afternoon for maintenance. Plan to download your materials in advance.

Title: Career talk: jobs in health economics
Message: An informal talk with graduates about careers in health economics and management.
